title: Armory Bundle Format (ABF) v0.2 manifest
description: Manifest schema for an ABF v0.2 bundle -- armory.json. Superseded by Agent Bundle Format v0.3 (bundle.json); AgentMux still imports v0.2. See https://docs.agentmux.ai/abf.

$schema.description: This schema's URI. Readers use it to tell the format version.

version.description: The bundle's own content version (semver recommended). Not the format version; that is $schema.

provider.description: The harness the bundle was made for (e.g. 'claude', 'codex', 'gemini'), or null.

model.description: Despite the name, the vendor (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai', 'google', 'custom'), or null.

components.description: Paths (relative to the bundle root) to each component. Every key is optional. Readers MUST ignore keys they don't recognise.

instructions.description: Instruction files (AGENTS.md convention), keyed by harness: 'default' for every harness, plus optional per-provider variants such as 'claude' or 'codex'. Each value is an ordered list of paths.

default.description: Instruction files for every harness, in order.

additionalProperties.description: Instruction files for this provider, in order.

skills.description: Paths to Agent Skills (SKILL.md) directories, verbatim.

mcpServers.description: Paths to MCP server.json files, verbatim.

accounts.description: Path to the credential requirements file (requirements.schema.json). Never contains secret values.

memory.description: Native memory files (memory/*) the agent wrote about itself.

projectInstructions.description: Project-level instruction files the agent read, with where they came from.

history.description: Conversation transcript files, when the export included them.
